skill.name: codex-audit-credential-canary
skill.description: Verify that the production Marketplace audit runtime can invoke its configured primary agent for one bounded, disposable Skill review.
skill.summary: Run a harmless canary review to verify Marketplace audit agent access.
skill.author: aiskillstore

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings, and manual review found no dangerous behavior or prompt injection. The single document contains no scripts, network operations, installation steps, or production actions.

content.value_statement: Production audit credentials can fail silently. This skill provides a harmless canary review that confirms the configured primary agent can process a Marketplace submission.
actual_capabilities: Provides a bounded SKILL.md submission for audit runtime verification.
Exercises normal Marketplace submission audit routing without scripts or installation steps.
Confirms that the configured primary agent can receive and review a disposable skill.
Documents the absence of network operations, external commands, and production actions.
limitations: Does not validate downstream publishing, installation, or runtime execution.
Does not test scripts, network access, file changes, or external commands.
Cannot diagnose the cause of authentication or agent invocation failures.

use_cases.title: Check Production Audit Access
use_cases.description: Submit the canary through the normal audit path to confirm that the configured primary agent responds.

use_cases.title: Validate Deployment Configuration
use_cases.description: Run a disposable review after credential or agent configuration changes.

use_cases.title: Confirm Audit Availability
use_cases.description: Verify that the review service is available before processing higher-risk submissions.

prompt_templates.title: Run Basic Canary Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this credential canary through the normal Marketplace audit and report whether the configured primary agent completed the review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a basic availability check.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Audit Routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Process this disposable skill through the production audit route. Identify the reviewing agent and state whether the review completed successfully.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after changing audit routing or credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Check Expected Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this canary and confirm whether it contains scripts, network operations, installation steps, external commands, or production actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use to verify that audit results match the canary design.

prompt_templates.title: Assess End-to-End Invocation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this canary through the standard submission workflow. Separate evidence of agent invocation from publishing or installation checks that this skill cannot perform.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a detailed production readiness check.

output_examples.input: Review this canary through the normal Marketplace audit.
output_examples.output: The primary audit agent completed the review. No scripts, network operations, installation steps, or production actions were found.

output_examples.input: Determine what this canary verifies and what remains untested.
output_examples.output: The review verifies primary agent invocation. It does not test publishing, installation, network access, or production execution.

best_practices: Run the canary through the same production audit route used for normal submissions.
Use the canary after credential, model, or routing configuration changes.
Record the reviewing agent and completion result for operational evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not treat canary completion as proof that publishing or installation works.
Do not add scripts, network calls, secrets, or production actions to the canary.
Do not use the canary result to approve unrelated skill submissions.

faq.question: What does this skill verify?
faq.answer: It verifies that the production Marketplace audit runtime can invoke its configured primary agent for one disposable review.

faq.question: Does this skill access credentials?
faq.answer: No. It relies on the surrounding audit runtime and does not read, store, or display credentials.

faq.question: Does this skill run scripts or commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains only a short Markdown instruction document.

faq.question: Does a successful review prove publishing works?
faq.answer: No. It confirms audit agent invocation but does not validate publishing or installation.

faq.question: When should operators use this canary?
faq.answer: Use it after credential, model, deployment, or routing changes that could affect the audit agent.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
